$comment: A derived template (packs/README.md 'Derived templates'): the services pack composed with a braids & natural-hair studio content seed (The Crown Room, Bed-Stuy, Brooklyn), a tangerine brand, and the crown register. Everything else — builders, sections, contract, tests — is the base pack's; compose expands this catalog through resolveCatalog (scripts/lib/pack-switch.mjs).
title: Braids & natural hair studio
description: A braids and natural-hair studio's site as a glossy late-90s cover: the name cast in chrome and gold over the cover photograph with its cover lines down the left, the starting prices as the strip under it, a style menu with every length, chair time, and price, a lookbook of real installs, an install-day before/after, the house rules on one card, and online booking for consults, installs, and retwists — a multi-page site edited in one content file.

content.$comment: Business-content contract seed override. resolveCatalog merges a remix's content per-domain over the base's, so this appointments seed replaces the base pack's at compose and mirrors THIS remix's contentSeed module entry for entry (the remix-seed tests pin the twin) — the composed template's booking widget and Manage calendar open on this studio's own chair, not the base demo business's.

types.name: Free style consult
types.description: Photos, your hair now, and the size, length, and price for your style — by video or at the chair.

types.name: Braid install
types.description: Knotless, boho, Fulani, or stitch — this holds your start; Dez keeps the rest of the day for your install. The exact style is set at your consult.

types.name: Locs retwist
types.description: Scalp cleanse, palm-roll or interlock retwist, and a style to finish.

theme.$comment: Tangerine as the brand: on the crown register the accent is the enamel on the asks, the big cover-line verbs, and the sparkle before every kicker, while the metals (gold, chrome) are the register's own spot inks, so a rebrand re-enamels the cover without re-casting the masthead. Marketing pages resolve brand over preset accent, so the overlay re-skins the pages and the app surfaces together. navigation re-pins the shared servicesShell chrome (a declared theme variant outranks the shell prop): the inline bar — wordmark and dateline left, the sections and the ask right, lifting into a card on scroll — apart from the base's split letterhead, the landscaping band, the painting masthead, and the makeup artist's split. mode dark opens on the plum cover stock (theme merges shallowly).

landing.$comment: The pin: the crown register and the cover home — the masthead-overlay hero (the name in chrome and gold, the gold-ruled billing line, the cover lines), the starting prices as a static strip straight under it (the seed's ticker), the style menu (price-list), the lookbook plates (specimens), the install-day before/after, the house rules card (checklist), the chair's reviews, the neighborhoods, and the closing banner. The seed hides the home services grid (home.serviceGrid) and leaves the coastal-builder build log and materials board empty. The lookbook page opens on the same looks as a filterable grid; the other pages keep the base's skeletons. resolveCatalog puts these in place of the base's pages.
